scope: Native Windows processes and pinned backend; synthetic CLI/telemetry and raw HUD key input
checks: two real source owners each open an independent waiting HUD before a hook
removed package-managed backend path attaches using the verified current bundle while retaining the original host proof
both HUDs start at six rows with the backend-specific separator geometry
compact rows stay adjacent and explicit six/eight-row resizing remains exact after viewport changes without changing the other server
native hook process ancestry binds A20% and B70% independently (synthetic CLI)
same thread in two source owners retains two displays; rebind does not duplicate
closing/reopening one HUD keeps the other source and display alive
live watch loop follows 3/6/3 content with exact native rows and unchanged neighbour
pending growth hides the pager and capped overflow restores it
narrower viewport grows wrapped content to seven rows without changing the other server
disabling live fitting keeps the manually/currently selected height
same running viewer updates actual tool running/completed/cancelled symbols as metadata arrives
same viewer updates agent lifecycle and retains the reported actual model
Ctrl+C keeps the HUD alive and q closes only its own viewer
source exit closes only its owned display
limitations: Renamed Node fixture, not official Codex; real hook trust/default shared-daemon behavior and actual interactive desktop use remain unverified.
Ctrl+C raw input survival is tested; OS clipboard selection/copy is not asserted.
